description: 测试资产工作台：左侧项目列表（可搜索），进入项目后按「模块 → 功能」组织用例与数据集；用例分接口 / UI 两类，含步骤、预期、优先级、状态与关联数据。数据存在本机数据目录，跨会话与项目共用同一份。
descriptionEn: Test asset workspace: a searchable project list on the left, then module / feature scoping inside a project. Cases are typed API or UI, with steps, expectations, priority, status and linked data. Data lives in the local data dir and is shared across sessions and projects.
